title: hiPSCs-SNaP: NGN2-induced NPCs
author: Sophie Cohen
materials: Induce Ngn2-eGFP-Neo(+Dox), Cas9v2 maintainance(+low hygro) in SNaP Medium

steps.title: Induce Ngn2 expression in hiPSCs
steps.instruction: Induce Ngn2‑eGFP‑Neo expression by adding doxycycline in SNaP medium while maintaining Cas9v2 with low hygromycin.

steps.title: Split cells and infect with gRNAs
steps.instruction: Split cultures into two GTx plates, seed 1 × 10⁶ cells per well of a 12‑well plate, and infect with ASD gRNA‑Puro.

steps.title: Coat 12‑well plates with 1× geltrex
steps.instruction: Add enough 1× geltrex to each well of a 12‑well plate to cover the surface, then incubate ~2 h before use.

steps.title: Detach and prepare cells for replating
steps.instruction: Treat cells with Accutase for 5–7 min at room temperature, transfer the suspension to three times the volume of DMEM, spin 5 min at 0.8 rcf, aspirate supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in SNaP medium containing chroman.

steps.title: Count and seed cells at 1 M per well
steps.instruction: Count the resuspended cells and seed 1 × 10⁶ cells per well of the geltrex‑coated 12‑well plate in SNaP medium with chroman (note: ~750 k cells per well may be optimal).

steps.title: First media change with doxycycline and hygromycin
steps.instruction: Replace existing medium with fresh SNaP medium supplemented with doxycycline at 1:500 dilution and hygromycin at 1:3500 dilution.

steps.title: Second media change with doxycycline and hygromycin
steps.instruction: Replace medium again with SNaP medium containing doxycycline (1:500) and hygromycin (1:3500).

steps.title: Third media change adding geneticin
steps.instruction: Replace medium with SNaP medium containing doxycycline (1:500), hygromycin (1:3500), and geneticin at 1:100 dilution.

steps.title: Coat new plates with 2× geltrex and re‑split
steps.instruction: Coat a fresh 12‑well plate with 2× geltrex and incubate ~2 h; then detach cells with Accutase for 15–20 min and re‑seed as required.
